svg.title: Abdulrehman Ajmal: React front, Python back, AI in the middle
svg.desc: A teal rack unit labelled Abdulrehman Ajmal, above a patch panel whose ports are labelled with the tools he works with. frontend: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, MUI; backend: Python, Django, FastAPI, Node.js; data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis; infrastructure: Docker, Linux, Traefik, Dokploy.
